text:
Maria (CSM): Heads up — we're seeing degraded outbound webhook delivery and delayed embedding writes impacting a subset of new onboarders in EU region. Two high-touch trials and three self-serve tenants flagged. Need coordinated customer comms and a short live office hours slot for any customers wanting immediate help.

Tom (SRE): Noted. Root cause looks like a combination of transient queue growth + a config regression on the routing layer. We're throttling retries to avoid overload; working a staged rollback. ETA for rollback test: ~25m.

Olivia (Customer Success): Can we share a concise status note that CS can paste into Intercom/Email? Customers asking for simple next steps.

Tom (SRE): Yes — draft below. It's short, non-technical. Please review.

Tom (SRE): ```Hi — we’re actively investigating an issue affecting API webhook deliveries and embedding writes for some accounts in EU. Our engineers are performing a rollback and expect service to be stable within the next hour. If you rely on live onboarding, we recommend pausing batch imports until we confirm recovery. We’ll send a follow-up when the rollback completes and welcome you to join an office hours session at <link>. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Inference Status Team```

Maria (CSM): Good. I'll personalize for the two high-touch trials and include account-specific mitigations (temp keys, manual export). Can someone confirm the office hours link + time? We should do a 30-min slot starting 45m from now.

Ben (Support): I'll spin up the Zoom and draft the Intercom event. Can someone from Solutions join for Q&A? @Emily?

Emily (Solutions): I can join. Also suggest running a quick health-check checklist for affected accounts so we can triage proactively during office hours. I'll post checklist shortly.

SRE Bot: deploy-rollback-job #482 queued by tom.sre — estimated start 00:05:00

Tom (SRE): Rollback started. Will post update when verified.

Emily (Solutions): Checklist (short):
- Verify webhook delivery backlog (if >1000, request manual drain)
- Confirm embedding writes completed for last 24h window
- Check client-side retry settings (advise exponential backoff)
- Provide temporary ingest window/pauses for high-throughput jobs

Olivia (Customer Success): Maria — can you prioritize customers with upcoming renewals first for outreach? We should log each outreach in the renewal risk tracker.

Maria (CSM): Yes — I'll call the two renewal-risk accounts after the rollback completes. Drafting call notes template: short empathy + what we did + credits/next steps.

Ben (Support): Office hours link: https://zoom.redwood/office-hours-317654 — scheduled in 40m. I'll create an Intercom post and a targeted email template for trials.

Tom (SRE): Rollback verified on canary, metrics look good. Beginning phased rollout. I'll update when EU region is fully green.

Maria (CSM): Sending initial status note to affected accounts now (copy pasted from Tom's draft + minor personalization). I'll mark outreach in the tracker and request follow-up if they want the live office hours.

Tom (SRE): EU region marked: 80% green, continuing rollout. Next update in 20m.

Olivia (Customer Success): Thanks all. Action items: Maria — outreach + renewal prioritization; Ben — office hours + Intercom; Emily — checklist + join office hours; Tom — final green confirmation and RCA ETA. We'll prepare a short customer-facing RCA after postmortem.

Maria (CSM): Will do. If any customer asks for immediate credits, escalate to Olivia.

Tom (SRE): Final: EU region fully recovered. Root cause: routing config regression caused retry amplification under burst traffic; fix included config rollback and backpressure tuning. Preparing internal RCA doc, will share a customer summary within 24h.

Maria (CSM): Noted. I'll send a follow-up email to affected accounts summarizing resolution + offer of 1:1 walkthrough for any data migration concerns.

Ben (Support): Closing thread for now — all actions captured in the incident tracker (link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/3176543210). :thumbsup:
